dict.string: Bluetooth connects nearby tour rooms and carries tour audio and controls when Wi-Fi is unavailable. Your location is not shared.
GetOverHere uses your local network to discover nearby channels and stream audio directly between devices without a backend.
Your location stays on this device and is used only to show your position, distance, and direction relative to the guide's shared pin.
GetOverHere needs microphone access to broadcast audio to nearby devices on your local network.
